nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Checks every hour for users who just hit milestones

nodes.name: MongoDB: Check Milestones
nodes.notes: Checks users updated in the last hour for milestone achievements. Milestones: first lesson, 10/50/100 lessons, streaks, contributions.

nodes.name: Detect Milestone Types
nodes.notes: Processes raw user data to detect specific milestones including streaks (calculated from timeSpentHistory). Marks significant milestones for social media posting.
